हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A misunderstanding turns violent when a man is mistaken for a stalker, only to reveal he’s a grieving father searching for his long-lost daughter, Naina. Years later, now a powerful yet secretive tycoon, he continues his search while battling betrayal, crime, and deception. As destinies collide, a lost daughter rises unknowingly close to him, facing love, betrayal, and identity. Watch now.
